```{r}
#| echo: false
capsule <- "results/reference/01_finemapping/separated-development-v1.1"
manifest <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(capsule, "benchmark_manifest.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
```

## Available benchmarks

### [Separated-locus fine-mapping development pilot](01_finemapping/separated-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete development benchmark |
| Study type | Separated-locus, scalar-trait fine-mapping |
| Methods | `r paste(manifest$methods, collapse = ", ")` |
| Replicates | `r manifest$replicate_count` |
| Data limitation | Example markers have limited LD; simulated inputs are publicly downloadable from a pinned qgdata revision |
| Capsule | [Improved v1.1 reproducibility capsule](../results/reference/01_finemapping/separated-development-v1.1/README.md) · [Original v1 capsule](../results/reference/01_finemapping/separated-development-v1/README.md) |

### [Single-trait prediction development benchmark](02_prediction/prediction-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete one-replicate development benchmark |
| Study type | Held-out single-trait prediction |
| Methods | ST-BED BayesC, ST-BED BayesR, ST-CSR SBayesC, ST-CSR SBayesR |
| Architectures | Sparse homogeneous and sparse variance mixture |
| Replicates | One per architecture |
| Validation | 8/8 successful fits; training-only scaling, LD and summary statistics |
| Capsule | [Prediction reproducibility capsule](../results/reference/02_prediction/st-bayesc-bayesr-one-replicate-development-v1/README.md) |

## Planned benchmarks

- Fine-mapping with realistic LD.
- High-LD causal architecture.
- Multi-replicate scientific-length prediction study.
- Single-trait parameter-estimation benchmark.
- Single-trait multichain convergence benchmark.
- Multi-trait prediction study after computational optimization.
- Annotation-informed models.
- Block-eigen methods.
